label: Biogeography
text: BI.O.A5.5 Biogeography. The spatial distribution of life, set by dispersal, barrier, climate and history. Endemism and disjunction are patterns needing a historical explanation. CONTESTED: alternative EA.O.A4 for the map pattern alone. Island biogeography theory (MacArthur–Wilson) holds under a balance of immigration and extinction depending on isolation and area; its equilibrium assumption is CONTESTED.

warrant.standard: Replicated field or mesocosm experiment; time series with stated uncertainty
warrant.defeaters: Pseudoreplication; scale mismatch; confounded gradients; detection bias
